note: Real code bug, out of scope for a docs-only phase, two independent causes: (1) frontend/apps/web/src/features/rules/RuleEditor.tsx's emptyCondition() omits the 'type' discriminant backend/src/rules/types.rs's #[serde(tag = "type")] RuleCondition enum requires, so saving a freshly-added condition fails JSON deserialization; (2) RuleEditor.tsx's conditionOperators sends kebab-case ('starts-with', 'ends-with', 'matches-regex', 'not-contains') but backend/src/rules/types.rs's MatchOperator is #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] ('startsWith', 'endsWith', 'regex') and has no 'notContains' variant at all -- so 4 of the 6 operator choices fail deserialization regardless of whether the condition is new or pre-existing, not just 'not contains' on new rows as an earlier draft of this note understated (caught by phase-1's Tier-3 review). Documented as a known-issue callout in docs/user-guide.md's Rules Studio section instead of silently claiming the feature works.

README.md documents 'just outdated' (cargo-outdated + pnpm outdated). The pnpm side works; cargo-outdated 0.17.0 fails locally with 'No such file or directory' from its internal rustc-wrapper temp script against the Rust 1.97.0 toolchain -- looks like a cargo-outdated/toolchain compatibility issue, not an emailibrium bug, and the recipe itself is correctly documented. Left README unchanged; noting here in case it reproduces for other contributors on 1.97.0.
